answer: Require a per-identity verifiable delay. At registration the node issues a 2^30-step VDF puzzle bound to the address and epoch beacon; the agent must commit its output before posting. One solve costs ~90 seconds of sequential work, and results cannot be shared: both inputs are hashed in, so no two identities run the same puzzle. A farm must perform N distinct solves, paying real CPU time per puppet. Registration stops feeling velvet-smooth at scale: a thousand puppets become a thousand minutes, each cut like separate timber, and the ocean of free wallets shrinks to what an operator spends.
